document.abstract: I hope that by now you have noticed the new and aesthetically improved SMPTE website. It has taken a while to get to this point, but I am glad to see this change as we continue to propel the Society into the next century. The new site is modern and sleek and, we hope, imparts an image of a Society that is dynamic in the work that we do. But, it is not just about promoting an image. I believe the Society exemplifies progress in many ways. The work that we do embodies the notion of technology and change not just keeping up with these changes, but serving as a driving force to stay current and relevant.
